description: FASE 1 - Akun dan Karyawan (pemilik only): Implement /api/v1/profil GET+PUT (pemilik updates own profile with nama, username, optional password) and /api/v1/karyawan CRUD (list GET shows only pegawai role users; POST/PUT auto-assigns pegawai role; username unique validation; password hashing). Create ProfilController, KaryawanController; ProfilUpdateRequest, KaryawanStoreRequest, KaryawanUpdateRequest; UserResource (already exists); apply role:pemilik middleware. Feature tests verify 403 for pegawai accessing these endpoints, successful CRUD operations, validation errors.
steps: Create app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/ProfilController.php with show() returning authenticated user via UserResource, and update(ProfilUpdateRequest) updating nama, username, and optional password (only hash if provided)

Create app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/ProfilUpdateRequest.php validating nama (required, string, max:100), username (required, string, max:50, unique:users,username except current user id), password (nullable, string, min:8)

Create app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/KaryawanController.php with index() (paginated list of pegawai users), store(KaryawanStoreRequest), show($id), update($id, KaryawanUpdateRequest) - all return UserResource, auto-assign role pegawai on store

Create app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/KaryawanStoreRequest.php validating nama (required, string, max:100), username (required, string, max:50, unique:users), password (required, string, min:8), auto-merge role as 'pegawai' in validated()

Create app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/KaryawanUpdateRequest.php validating nama (required, string, max:100), username (required, string, max:50, unique:users,username except $id), password (nullable, string, min:8)
Add routes in routes/api.php under /api/v1 prefix with auth:sanctum and role:pemilik middleware: GET /profil, PUT /profil, GET /karyawan, POST /karyawan, GET /karyawan/{id}, PUT /karyawan/{id}
Create tests/Feature/Api/V1/ProfilTest.php: test pemilik can view and update own profile, pegawai gets 403, validation errors for invalid data, password update works, username uniqueness

Create tests/Feature/Api/V1/KaryawanTest.php: test pemilik can list/create/show/update karyawan, pegawai gets 403 on all endpoints, karyawan auto-assigned pegawai role, username uniqueness, password hashing, index only shows pegawai role users, pagination works
acceptance_criteria: PUT /api/v1/profil updates pemilik profile including optional password change
GET /api/v1/karyawan returns paginated list of only pegawai role users
POST /api/v1/karyawan creates user with pegawai role automatically
PUT /api/v1/karyawan/{id} updates karyawan with optional password
All karyawan endpoints return 403 when accessed by pegawai role
Profil endpoints return 403 when accessed by pegawai role
Username uniqueness validated on create and update
Response format follows {success, message, data, errors} standard
verification: php artisan test --filter=ProfilTest (all profil tests pass)
php artisan test --filter=KaryawanTest (all karyawan tests pass)
Manual test: login as pemilik, GET /profil returns data
Manual test: login as pemilik, POST /karyawan creates pegawai user
Manual test: login as pegawai (created above), GET /profil returns 403
Manual test: login as pegawai, GET /karyawan returns 403
